wrong: The number of international students applying for scholarships have risen sharply.
correct: The number of international students applying for scholarships has risen sharply.
ruleVi: 'The number of + danh từ số nhiều' luôn đi với động từ số ít ('has risen').

wrong: A large proportion of household budgets are spent on rent in major cities.
correct: A large proportion of household budgets is spent on rent in major cities.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là 'A large proportion' (hoặc phần không đếm được), nên chia động từ số ít 'is spent'.

wrong: Each of the proposed climate policies require substantial public funding.
correct: Each of the proposed climate policies requires substantial public funding.
ruleVi: 'Each of + danh từ số nhiều' luôn chia động từ số ít ('requires').

wrong: Neither the municipal council nor local businesses has approved the toll plan.
correct: Neither the municipal council nor local businesses have approved the toll plan.
ruleVi: Với 'Neither A nor B', động từ chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất ('local businesses' -> số nhiều 'have approved').

wrong: The rapid expansion of online retail, combined with rising rents, have forced many shops to close.
correct: The rapid expansion of online retail, combined with rising rents, has forced many shops to close.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là 'The rapid expansion' (số ít); cụm 'combined with...' không làm chủ ngữ thành số nhiều.

wrong: Investing heavily in early childhood education yield measurable long-term returns.
correct: Investing heavily in early childhood education yields measurable long-term returns.
ruleVi: Danh động từ làm chủ ngữ ('Investing...') luôn đi với động từ số ít ('yields').

wrong: There is several compelling reasons why urban cycling should be subsidised.
correct: There are several compelling reasons why urban cycling should be subsidised.
ruleVi: Danh từ đứng sau là 'several compelling reasons' (số nhiều) nên phải dùng 'There are'.

wrong: One of the most pressing challenges facing cities today are air pollution.
correct: One of the most pressing challenges facing cities today is air pollution.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là 'One' (số ít) trong 'One of the most pressing challenges...', nên động từ là 'is'.

wrong: The percentage of graduates working remotely have doubled since 2019.
correct: The percentage of graduates working remotely has doubled since 2019.
ruleVi: 'The percentage of...' làm chủ ngữ luôn đi với động từ số ít ('has doubled').

wrong: Everybody who commutes during peak hours know how stressful gridlock can be.
correct: Everybody who commutes during peak hours knows how stressful gridlock can be.
ruleVi: Đại từ bất định 'Everybody / Everyone' luôn chia động từ số ít ('knows').

wrong: Modern hospitals rely on advanced medical equipments to diagnose patients early.
correct: Modern hospitals rely on advanced medical equipment to diagnose patients early.
ruleVi: 'equipment' là danh từ không đếm được, không bao giờ thêm -s.

wrong: Governments must provide clearer informations about how personal data is stored.
correct: Governments must provide clearer information about how personal data is stored.
ruleVi: 'information' không đếm được; muốn đếm phải dùng 'pieces of information'.

wrong: Recent researches indicate that green spaces significantly lower urban stress.
correct: Recent research indicates that green spaces significantly lower urban stress.
ruleVi: 'research' là danh từ không đếm được nên không thêm -s và chia động từ số ít ('indicates').

wrong: University advisors offer valuable advices on career planning and internships.
correct: University advisors offer valuable advice on career planning and internships.
ruleVi: 'advice' không đếm được; không thêm -s hay dùng 'an advice'.

wrong: Tourists frequently struggle to find affordable accommodations near the city centre.
correct: Tourists frequently struggle to find affordable accommodation near the city centre.
ruleVi: Trong tiếng Anh Anh chuẩn IELTS, 'accommodation' là danh từ không đếm được.

wrong: The study highlights a dramatic rise in the amount of private cars on city roads.
correct: The study highlights a dramatic rise in the number of private cars on city roads.
ruleVi: 'cars' là danh từ đếm được số nhiều nên phải dùng 'the number of', không dùng 'the amount of'.

wrong: Less commuters used the suburban rail line after ticket prices increased.
correct: Fewer commuters used the suburban rail line after ticket prices increased.
ruleVi: Dùng 'Fewer' với danh từ đếm được số nhiều ('commuters'), không dùng 'Less'.

wrong: Too many traffic during rush hour increases both fuel waste and stress.
correct: Too much traffic during rush hour increases both fuel waste and stress.
ruleVi: 'traffic' là danh từ không đếm được nên phải đi với 'too much'.

wrong: The new curriculum gives students practical knowledges about personal finance.
correct: The new curriculum gives students practical knowledge about personal finance.
ruleVi: 'knowledge' là danh từ không đếm được, không dùng ở dạng số nhiều 'knowledges'.

wrong: Passengers are permitted to bring two luggages onto the regional coach.
correct: Passengers are permitted to bring two pieces of luggage onto the regional coach.
ruleVi: 'luggage' không đếm được; muốn nêu số lượng phải dùng 'pieces/items of luggage'.

wrong: The society as a whole benefits when public healthcare is universally accessible.
correct: Society as a whole benefits when public healthcare is universally accessible.
ruleVi: Khi nói đến 'xã hội nói chung' (nghĩa khái quát), không dùng mạo từ 'The' trước 'Society'.

wrong: Pollution poses serious threat to marine biodiversity along coastal zones.
correct: Pollution poses a serious threat to marine biodiversity along coastal zones.
ruleVi: Danh từ đếm được số ít 'threat' bắt buộc phải có mạo từ: 'pose a serious threat to'.

wrong: A number of European nations have invested heavily in an renewable energy.
correct: A number of European nations have invested heavily in renewable energy.
ruleVi: 'renewable' bắt đầu bằng phụ âm /r/ và 'energy' là danh từ không đếm được nói chung -> bỏ 'an'.

wrong: According to the chart, the United Kingdom spent more on rail than the France.
correct: According to the chart, the United Kingdom spent more on rail than France.
ruleVi: Không dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên quốc gia số ít như France, Japan, Vietnam (chỉ dùng với the UK, the US, the Netherlands).

wrong: Students who study abroad gain valuable experience and an unique cultural outlook.
correct: Students who study abroad gain valuable experience and a unique cultural outlook.
ruleVi: 'unique' phát âm bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /j/ (/juːˈniːk/), nên phải dùng 'a unique', không phải 'an'.

wrong: The internet has become indispensable tool for modern academic research.
correct: The internet has become an indispensable tool for modern academic research.
ruleVi: Danh từ số ít 'tool' cần mạo từ 'an' trước nguyên âm /ɪ/ của 'indispensable'.

wrong: Many graduates aspire to work in European Union after completing their master's degree.
correct: Many graduates aspire to work in the European Union after completing their master's degree.
ruleVi: Các khối liên minh có danh từ chung như Union, Kingdom, States bắt buộc có 'the'.

wrong: Government should invest more in vocational training for unemployed youth.
correct: The government should invest more in vocational training for unemployed youth.
ruleVi: 'Government' ở dạng số ít đếm được cần mạo từ 'The government' (hoặc dùng số nhiều 'Governments').

wrong: Honest discussion is essential; it took over a hour to reach an agreement.
correct: Honest discussion is essential; it took over an hour to reach an agreement.
ruleVi: Chữ 'h' trong 'hour' là âm câm (/ˈaʊə/), nên phải dùng mạo từ 'an hour'.

wrong: Excessive screen exposure has a negative impact to children's sleep quality.
correct: Excessive screen exposure has a negative impact on children's sleep quality.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn luôn là 'have an impact/effect ON something', không dùng 'to'.

wrong: In my opinion, parents are largely responsible of monitoring their children online.
correct: In my opinion, parents are largely responsible for monitoring their children online.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'be responsible FOR + N/V-ing'.

wrong: The essay will discuss about the economic benefits of remote employment.
correct: The essay will discuss the economic benefits of remote employment.
ruleVi: 'discuss' là ngoại động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ, KHÔNG thêm giới từ 'about'.

wrong: Many rural clinics suffer a chronic shortage of qualified medical staff.
correct: Many rural clinics suffer from a chronic shortage of qualified medical staff.
ruleVi: Cụm động từ chuẩn khi nói chịu đựng khó khăn/thiếu hụt là 'suffer FROM'.

wrong: High-speed rail offers an eco-friendly alternative than short-haul domestic flights.
correct: High-speed rail offers an eco-friendly alternative to short-haul domestic flights.
ruleVi: 'alternative' luôn đi với giới từ 'to' ('an alternative to X').

wrong: Public libraries play a vital role in providing equal access for digital resources.
correct: Public libraries play a vital role in providing equal access to digital resources.
ruleVi: Danh từ 'access' luôn đi với giới từ 'to' ('access to education/resources').

wrong: Despite of strict speed limits, road accidents remain common during wet weather.
correct: Despite strict speed limits, road accidents remain common during wet weather.
ruleVi: 'Despite' KHÔNG bao giờ đi kèm 'of' (chỉ 'In spite of' mới có 'of').

wrong: Urban temperatures rose sharply between 1990 to 2020 across southern Europe.
correct: Urban temperatures rose sharply between 1990 and 2020 across southern Europe.
ruleVi: Cặp giới từ chuẩn là 'between X AND Y' hoặc 'from X TO Y', tuyệt đối không trộn 'between... to'.

wrong: Young workers often struggle to cope up with soaring metropolitan housing costs.
correct: Young workers often struggle to cope with soaring metropolitan housing costs.
ruleVi: Cụm đúng là 'cope with' (đối phó với); không có từ 'up' ở giữa.

wrong: According to me, subsidising renewable power is the wisest long-term strategy.
correct: In my view, subsidising renewable power is the wisest long-term strategy.
ruleVi: Trong tiếng Anh học thuật không dùng 'According to me'; dùng 'In my view,' hoặc 'From my perspective,'.

wrong: Although renewable energy is initially costly, but it saves money in the long run.
correct: Although renewable energy is initially costly, it saves money in the long run.
ruleVi: Trong tiếng Anh không dùng đồng thời cả 'Although' lẫn 'but' trong cùng một câu.

wrong: Public transport is affordable, however, many residents still prefer private cars.
correct: Public transport is affordable; however, many residents still prefer private cars.
ruleVi: 'however' là trạng từ liên kết, không nối hai mệnh đề độc lập chỉ bằng dấu phẩy (lỗi comma splice); phải dùng dấu.

wrong: Because of air pollution is worsening, several cities have introduced low-emission zones.
correct: Because air pollution is worsening, several cities have introduced low-emission zones.
ruleVi: 'Because of' chỉ đi với cụm danh từ; trước một mệnh đề có chủ-vị phải dùng 'Because'.

wrong: While working from home reduces commuting time. It can weaken team cohesion.
correct: While working from home reduces commuting time, it can weaken team cohesion.
ruleVi: 'While + mệnh đề' là mệnh đề phụ, không được tách thành câu độc lập (lỗi sentence fragment).

wrong: Because traffic congestion wastes hours daily, so employers should allow flexible start times.
correct: Because traffic congestion wastes hours daily, employers should allow flexible start times.
ruleVi: Không dùng đồng thời cả 'Because' và 'so' trong cùng một câu.

wrong: Even though the high tuition fees, demand for overseas degrees continues to climb.
correct: Despite the high tuition fees, demand for overseas degrees continues to climb.
ruleVi: 'Even though' cần một mệnh đề đầy đủ; trước cụm danh từ 'the high tuition fees' phải dùng 'Despite'.

wrong: The reason why obesity is rising is because processed food is cheap and convenient.
correct: The reason why obesity is rising is that processed food is cheap and convenient.
ruleVi: Tránh lặp nghĩa 'The reason ... is because'; cấu trúc chuẩn là 'The reason ... is that...'.

wrong: Not only the new metro line eases congestion, but it also lowers carbon emissions.
correct: Not only does the new metro line ease congestion, but it also lowers carbon emissions.
ruleVi: Khi 'Not only' đứng đầu câu, bắt buộc phải đảo ngữ: 'Not only + does/do/did + S + V nguyên thể'.

wrong: Many graduates lack practical skills, therefore, universities should expand internships.
correct: Many graduates lack practical skills; therefore, universities should expand internships.
ruleVi: Tránh lỗi comma splice với 'therefore': dùng dấu chấm phẩy trước và dấu phẩy sau ('; therefore,').

wrong: Whether cities expand bike lanes or not depend largely on political willpower.
correct: Whether cities expand bike lanes or not depends largely on political willpower.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề danh ngữ 'Whether...' làm chủ ngữ luôn chia động từ số ít ('depends').

wrong: Expanding rural broadband can significant improve access to university courses.
correct: Expanding rural broadband can significantly improve access to university courses.
ruleVi: Cần trạng từ 'significantly' để bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'improve', không dùng tính từ 'significant'.

wrong: Governments must take decisive act to protect coastal wetlands from erosion.
correct: Governments must take decisive action to protect coastal wetlands from erosion.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn là 'take decisive action' (danh từ không đếm được 'action').

wrong: The economic of renewable energy has shifted dramatically over the past decade.
correct: The economics of renewable energy has shifted dramatically over the past decade.
ruleVi: 'economics' (danh từ, chia số ít) chỉ khía cạnh/bài toán kinh tế; 'economic' chỉ là tính từ.

wrong: Electric scooters provide a very economy way to travel short urban distances.
correct: Electric scooters provide a very economical way to travel short urban distances.
ruleVi: 'economical' nghĩa là tiết kiệm chi phí; khác với 'economic' (thuộc nền kinh tế) và danh từ 'economy'.

wrong: Long working hours can have a harm effect on parents' relationships with children.
correct: Long working hours can have a harmful effect on parents' relationships with children.
ruleVi: Trước danh từ 'effect' cần tính từ 'harmful', không dùng danh từ/động từ 'harm'.

wrong: Rapid urbanisation has led to the destroy of valuable agricultural land.
correct: Rapid urbanisation has led to the destruction of valuable agricultural land.
ruleVi: Sau mạo từ 'the' và trước 'of' phải dùng danh từ 'destruction'.

wrong: Regular exercise is extreme beneficial for both physical stamina and mood.
correct: Regular exercise is extremely beneficial for both physical stamina and mood.
ruleVi: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'beneficial' phải dùng trạng từ 'extremely'.

wrong: A lack of sleep can make drivers feel tiring and slow their reaction speed.
correct: A lack of sleep can make drivers feel tired and slow their reaction speed.
ruleVi: Tính từ mô tả cảm xúc con người dùng đuôi -ed ('tired'), không dùng -ing ('tiring' mô tả vật/việc gây mệt).

wrong: Schools should teach students how to evaluate online news sources critical.
correct: Schools should teach students how to evaluate online news sources critically.
ruleVi: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'evaluate' cần trạng từ 'critically'.

wrong: Between 2000 and 2010, the price of wheat raised sharply from $120 to $260 per tonne.
correct: Between 2000 and 2010, the price of wheat rose sharply from $120 to $260 per tonne.
ruleVi: 'rise' là nội động từ (tự tăng -> quá khứ 'rose'); 'raise' là ngoại động từ cần tân ngữ đi sau.

wrong: The proportion of solar power was increased from 4% in 2010 to 19% in 2020.
correct: The proportion of solar power increased from 4% in 2010 to 19% in 2020.
ruleVi: Động từ mô tả xu hướng số liệu như increase, rise, fall, drop dùng ở dạng chủ động, không dùng bị động.

wrong: By 2035, electric vehicle sales are expecting to surpass petrol models.
correct: By 2035, electric vehicle sales are expected to surpass petrol models.
ruleVi: Dự báo tương lai ở Task 1 phải dùng bị động 'be expected/projected to + V'.

wrong: In 1995, the unemployment rate was stood at 8.5% before falling gradually.
correct: In 1995, the unemployment rate stood at 8.5% before falling gradually.
ruleVi: 'stand at' là nội động từ không bao giờ chia bị động ('stood at', không phải 'was stood at').

wrong: Over the twenty-year period, coal usage fell dramatically to 30% to 10%.
correct: Over the twenty-year period, coal usage fell dramatically from 30% to 10%.
ruleVi: Diễn tả điểm bắt đầu và kết thúc của sự thay đổi dùng 'from X to Y'.

wrong: The number of museum visitors peaked in 4.2 million in July 2019.
correct: The number of museum visitors peaked at 4.2 million in July 2019.
ruleVi: Động từ 'peak' luôn đi với giới từ 'at' trước con số ('peaked at 4.2 million').

wrong: In 2015, Japan spent 20 percents of its energy budget on wind turbines.
correct: In 2015, Japan spent 20 percent of its energy budget on wind turbines.
ruleVi: 'percent' không bao giờ thêm -s khi đi sau con số ('20 percent' hoặc '20%').

wrong: The chart illustrates the amount of households owning electric bicycles since 2015.
correct: The chart illustrates the number of households owning electric bicycles since 2015.
ruleVi: 'households' đếm được nên phải dùng 'the number of households'.

wrong: There was a significantly increase in online grocery orders during 2020.
correct: There was a significant increase in online grocery orders during 2020.
ruleVi: Trước danh từ 'increase' phải là tính từ 'significant', không dùng trạng từ 'significantly'.

wrong: The figure for France was twice higher than that for Italy in 2018.
correct: The figure for France was twice as high as that for Italy in 2018.
ruleVi: So sánh gấp đôi không dùng 'twice higher than'; cấu trúc chuẩn là 'twice as high as'.

wrong: The new recycling plant was built in 2018 and has been operate smoothly ever since.
correct: The new recycling plant was built in 2018 and has operated smoothly ever since.
ruleVi: 'operate' mang nghĩa vận hành chủ động ở đây -> dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành 'has operated'.

wrong: Higher fuel taxes can discourage motorists to drive into congested city centres.
correct: Higher fuel taxes can discourage motorists from driving into congested city centres.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc bắt buộc của 'discourage' là 'discourage sb FROM + V-ing'.

wrong: Subsidised rail passes encourage commuters switching from private cars to trains.
correct: Subsidised rail passes encourage commuters to switch from private cars to trains.
ruleVi: 'encourage + O + to V' (khác với 'discourage + O + from V-ing').

wrong: The municipal council suggested to expand evening bus services along outer routes.
correct: The municipal council suggested expanding evening bus services along outer routes.
ruleVi: Động từ 'suggest' đi với V-ing ('suggested expanding') hoặc 'suggest that + S + V', KHÔNG dùng 'suggest to V'.

wrong: Strict workplace laws prevent employers to underpay part-time university staff.
correct: Strict workplace laws prevent employers from underpaying part-time university staff.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'prevent + O + FROM + V-ing'.

wrong: Many developing regions cannot afford building high-speed rail networks independently.
correct: Many developing regions cannot afford to build high-speed rail networks independently.
ruleVi: 'afford' luôn đi với động từ nguyên thể có to ('afford to V').

wrong: The workshop enabled graduate students developing practical data visualisation skills.
correct: The workshop enabled graduate students to develop practical data visualisation skills.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'enable + O + to V'.

wrong: After the raw timber is shredded, it is transport to a heated drying chamber.
correct: After the raw timber is shredded, it is transported to a heated drying chamber.
ruleVi: Thể bị động bắt buộc dùng phân từ quá khứ V3/ed ('is transported').

wrong: Public parks, that provide vital cooling in summer, deserve greater municipal funding.
correct: Public parks, which provide vital cooling in summer, deserve greater municipal funding.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) TUYỆT ĐỐI không dùng 'that'; phải dùng 'which'.

wrong: Students which graduate with strong digital skills tend to secure employment faster.
correct: Students who graduate with strong digital skills tend to secure employment faster.
ruleVi: Thay thế cho chủ ngữ chỉ người ('Students') phải dùng 'who' (hoặc 'that'), không dùng 'which'.

wrong: Remote work cuts daily commuting time, what significantly improves family wellbeing.
correct: Remote work cuts daily commuting time, which significantly improves family wellbeing.
ruleVi: Đại từ quan hệ thay thế cho cả mệnh đề đứng trước là ', which', không dùng ', what'.

wrong: The city where I visited last autumn has transformed its waterfront into a park.
correct: The city that I visited last autumn has transformed its waterfront into a park.
ruleVi: 'visit' là ngoại động từ cần tân ngữ trực tiếp -> dùng 'that/which I visited', không dùng 'where'.

wrong: Small firms whose revenues fell sharply during the crisis received emergency grants, which helped it survive.
correct: Small firms whose revenues fell sharply during the crisis received emergency grants, which helped them survive.
ruleVi: Danh từ quy chiếu là 'Small firms' (số nhiều) nên đại từ phải là 'them', không phải 'it'.

wrong: The policy applies to all residents who their annual income falls below the threshold.
correct: The policy applies to all residents whose annual income falls below the threshold.
ruleVi: Diễn đạt quan hệ sở hữu trong mệnh đề quan hệ dùng 'whose + danh từ'.

wrong: There are many online platforms in where learners can practise spoken English.
correct: There are many online platforms where learners can practise spoken English.
ruleVi: 'where' đã bao hàm giới từ ('in which'); không bao giờ viết 'in where'.

wrong: The report highlights several cities in Europe which public transport is entirely free.
correct: The report highlights several cities in Europe in which public transport is entirely free.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề sau đã đủ chủ-vị-bổ ngữ ('public transport is free') nên cần 'where' hoặc 'in which'.

wrong: If governments would invest more in preventative care, hospital costs would decline.
correct: If governments invested more in preventative care, hospital costs would decline.
ruleVi: Trong mệnh đề 'If' của câu điều kiện loại 2 chỉ dùng quá khứ đơn ('invested'), không dùng 'would'.

wrong: Had cities upgraded flood barriers earlier, the coastal damage would not be so severe last year.
correct: Had cities upgraded flood barriers earlier, the coastal damage would not have been so severe last year.
ruleVi: Sự việc xảy ra 'last year' (quá khứ) nên vế chính điều kiện loại 3 phải là 'would not have been'.

wrong: Seldom policymakers confront a challenge as complex as demographic ageing.
correct: Seldom do policymakers confront a challenge as complex as demographic ageing.
ruleVi: Trạng từ phủ định 'Seldom' đứng đầu câu bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ: 'Seldom do policymakers confront'.

wrong: Only when consumers change their habits will companies to adopt sustainable packaging.
correct: Only when consumers change their habits will companies adopt sustainable packaging.
ruleVi: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu 'will' là động từ nguyên thể không to ('adopt').

wrong: Were tuition fees to be abolished completely, university budgets will face severe shortfalls.
correct: Were tuition fees to be abolished completely, university budgets would face severe shortfalls.
ruleVi: 'Were ... to V' là đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 2, nên vế chính phải dùng 'would + V', không dùng 'will'.

wrong: Unless strict emission targets are not enforced, industrial pollution will keep rising.
correct: Unless strict emission targets are enforced, industrial pollution will keep rising.
ruleVi: 'Unless' bản thân đã mang nghĩa phủ định ('If ... not'), nên tuyệt đối không thêm 'not' phía sau.

wrong: Never before the global economy has been so closely interconnected.
correct: Never before has the global economy been so closely interconnected.
ruleVi: Cụm phủ định 'Never before' đứng đầu câu bắt buộc đảo 'has' lên trước chủ ngữ.

wrong: Should the pilot programme succeeds, the council will expand it to ten districts.
correct: Should the pilot programme succeed, the council will expand it to ten districts.
ruleVi: Trong đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1 'Should + S + V', động từ chính luôn ở dạng nguyên thể ('succeed').

wrong: Rapid technological change brings a lot of big problems for older workers.
correct: Rapid technological change brings significant challenges for older workers.
ruleVi: Tránh văn nói 'a lot of big problems' trong IELTS Writing; dùng 'significant challenges'.

wrong: Governments must do stronger efforts to curb illegal logging in protected forests.
correct: Governments must make greater efforts to curb illegal logging in protected forests.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn của 'effort' là 'make an effort / make efforts', không dùng 'do'.

wrong: Spending excessive time on smartphones can make harm to young people's eyesight.
correct: Spending excessive time on smartphones can cause harm to young people's eyesight.
ruleVi: Dùng 'cause harm to' hoặc 'do harm to', không dùng 'make harm to'.

wrong: Many young graduates struggle to find a high salary job straight after university.
correct: Many young graduates struggle to find a well-paid job straight after university.
ruleVi: Cụm tự nhiên chuẩn bản xứ là 'a well-paid job' hoặc 'a lucrative career'.

wrong: Nowadays, technology is very convenient for students to open their mind.
correct: Nowadays, technology is very convenient for students to broaden their horizons.
ruleVi: Tránh dịch word-by-word từ tiếng Việt ('mở mang đầu óc'); dùng 'broaden their horizons'.

wrong: It is undeniable that urban green spaces bring lots of merits for city dwellers.
correct: It is undeniable that urban green spaces offer numerous benefits to city dwellers.
ruleVi: Tránh 'lots of' và lỗi giới từ; dùng 'offer numerous benefits to'.

wrong: Students should pay more attention on developing critical thinking rather than rote memorisation.
correct: Students should pay greater attention to developing critical thinking rather than rote memorisation.
ruleVi: Collocation cố định là 'pay attention TO', không dùng 'on'.

wrong: In my opinion, parents must take a good example for their children to follow.
correct: In my opinion, parents must set a good example for their children to follow.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn để nói 'làm gương tốt' là 'set a good example', không dùng 'take'.

wrong: Electric buses are significantly more quieter and cleaner than diesel fleets.
correct: Electric buses are significantly quieter and cleaner than diesel fleets.
ruleVi: Không dùng so sánh kép 'more' với tính từ ngắn đã thêm -er ('quieter').

wrong: The cost of living in central London is much higher than Manchester.
correct: The cost of living in central London is much higher than that in Manchester.
ruleVi: So sánh phải đồng đẳng: so sánh 'The cost of living' với 'that in Manchester', không so sánh giá cả với thành phố.

wrong: A balanced diet helps improve concentration, boosting immunity, and sleep quality.
correct: A balanced diet helps improve concentration, boost immunity, and enhance sleep quality.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc song song (parallelism): 'improve X, boost Y, and enhance Z' cùng dạng động từ nguyên thể.

wrong: Walking to work every morning, the air quality felt noticeably fresher along the river.
correct: Walking to work every morning, commuters noticed that the air felt noticeably fresher along the river.
ruleVi: Lỗi dangling modifier: 'Walking to work' phải bổ nghĩa cho chủ ngữ là con người ('commuters'), không phải 'the air quality'.

wrong: Solar panels are now far more cheaper to install than they were fifteen years ago.
correct: Solar panels are now far cheaper to install than they were fifteen years ago.
ruleVi: Không ghép 'more' với 'cheaper'; chỉ dùng 'far cheaper'.

wrong: Online platforms allow learners to study flexibly, saving commute time, and access global lectures.
correct: Online platforms allow learners to study flexibly, save commute time, and access global lectures.
ruleVi: Đảm bảo song song sau 'allow learners to': 'study..., save..., and access...'.

wrong: Compared with the older generation, young adults' digital literacy is far higher.
correct: Compared with the older generation, young adults possess far higher digital literacy is far higher.
ruleVi: Sau 'Compared with the older generation,', chủ ngữ mệnh đề chính phải là con người ('young adults'), không phải 'digital literacy'.

wrong: This scheme is not only beneficial for rural farmers but also urban consumers.
correct: This scheme is beneficial not only for rural farmers but also urban consumers.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc song song 'not only ... but also': đặt 'not only' ngay trước 'for rural farmers' để cân với 'but also (for) urban consumers'.
